arrive.text: The long way home, along the boardwalk through the swamp.

strike_1.text: Lightning. It takes you apart, all of you, in an instant.

strike_2.text: And by sheer chance, at the same moment, it turns the dead tree into an exact copy of you. Every atom in place. Every memory.

dog.text: The dog sniffs you for a long time. Then, slowly, it wags its tail.

frogs.text: Two frogs on the lily pad, where there used to be one. They look at each other.

home_idle.text: Your friend comes down to the path, to fetch you in.

home_1.text: You go in. You know where the mugs are. You know your friend takes two sugars.

home_2.text: Nobody will ever know the difference. Did you recognise your friend? Or did you only seem to?

tell_1.text: Your friend doesn't believe a word of it.

tell_2.text: Same face, same voice, same memories. Some people say that makes you the same person. Others say the one who walked into the swamp never came out.

back_1.text: You go back to the swamp, to look for yourself. There's only a scorch mark, and the black water.

back_2.text: Nobody else is coming home tonight. Only you. If it is you.
